label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: Reaching the first product by Tab took about 45 key presses: header links, then every category shown twice (once as an image link, once as a text link), then the same category list again as filter links, before any product.
No skip link or shortcut to the product list; the filter buttons and two copies of the category list sit between the menu and the products.
Several controls have no name: a link and a button with only an icon, and an icon button just before Add to bag, so I could not tell what they do.
Size choices are plain links, not a labelled group of options. After pressing Enter on XS nothing told me whether it was selected, and low stock was only shown as visible text.

After Add to bag the cart panel opened at the end of the page but focus stayed on the button. Nothing announced the item was added, the header still said Cart 0, and Tab did not lead into the panel, so I could not reach the Checkout button.
